intro: Football is Jordan's biggest sport, and the national team has risen fast in Asia.

chapters.title: Football
text: Jordan reached the final of the 2023 Asian Cup, played in early 2024, and qualified for its first World Cup in 2026. Al-Faisaly and Al-Wehdat are the big rival clubs.

chapters.title: Taekwondo
text: Ahmad Abughaush won Jordan's first Olympic gold in taekwondo in 2016.
